title: Simple trust
description: A simple trust plugin with simple commands.
body:
## SimpleTrust

SimpleTrust is a lightweight, no-frills PvP trust plugin for Bukkit/Spigot/Paper servers.
It lets players build a personal trust list — anyone on that list cannot deal damage to them,
whether through melee, bows, or any other projectile. No grief, no accidents, no excuses.

Trust is one-directional and fully player-controlled. If PlayerA trusts PlayerB,
PlayerB cannot hit PlayerA — but PlayerA can still hit PlayerB unless they also trust back.
Admins can fine-tune limits per server through a simple config.

---

## Features

- `/trust <player>` — Add or remove a player from your trust list (toggles)
- `/trust list` — View everyone you currently trust
- `/trust reload` — Reload the config live without restarting (admin only)
- `/untrust <player>` — Explicitly remove a player from your trust list
- Configurable outgoing and incoming trust limits
- Blocks both melee and projectile damage (arrows are removed on cancel)
- Fully configurable messages with `&` color codes and `{limit}` placeholder support

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/trust <player>` | Trust / untrust a player | default |
| `/trust list` | View your trust list | default |
| `/trust reload` | Reload plugin config | `simpletrust.admin` |
| `/untrust <player>` | Remove a player from your trust list | default |

Aliases: `/t` for `/trust`, `/unt` for `/untrust`

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `simpletrust.admin` | Access to `/trust reload` | OP |

---

## Configuration

<details>
<summary>default config.yml</summary>

# SimpleTrust Configuration
send-warning-message: true
warning-message: "&cYou trust this player, so you cannot hit them!"

# Trust Limits
max-trusted-by-player: 4       # Max players one person can trust (-1 = unlimited)
max-trusting-this-player: -1   # Max incoming trust a player can receive (-1 = unlimited)

# Error Messages  (supports {limit} placeholder)
limit-reached-self: "&cYou can only trust up to {limit} players!"
limit-reached-target: "&cThat player already has {limit} people trusting them!"
self-trust-blocked: "&cYou cannot trust yourself!"


</details>
